Team — quick context and asks to get the rollout moving. TL;DR: Lumina signed for Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equivalent nodes) with private VPC deployment and 12-month reserved capacity. Deal ID LUM-8673; DocuSign completed this morning.

What we sold / constraints:
- Model: open-llm/x-large (customer will bring model artifacts)
- Deployment: private VPC in us-west-2, expected production qps ~150 during peak
- Data: PHI-permitted, customer requires SOC2 evidence and audit logs retention for 12 months
- Go-live target: 2026-10-20 (customer requests go-live window in that week)

Key artifacts attached / links:
- SOW: Lumina_Health_SOW_v2.pdf (attached)
- Network requirements: network_requirements.xlsx (attached)
- Security questionnaire (completed): security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (attached)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/LUM-8673
- DocuSign record: https://www.docusign.com/records/LUM-8673-signed

Asks / next steps (please action):
1) Primary CS/implementation owner: please nominate a single owner to lead A->B (sales->cs) accountability and own the kickoff.
2) Schedule 60–90m technical kickoff with Lumina (network, security, app owners) in next 5 business days. Lumina prefers mornings PT.
3) Confirm security evidence owner for SOC2 artifacts and who will coordinate the audit packet.
4) Validate network checklist items and collect AWS account IDs, VPC CIDRs, and contact for VPN/VLAN ticketing (see attached network_requirements.xlsx).
5) Procurement/billing contact: contracts@luminahealth.com (they will handle invoicing cadence).

Known risks / blockers:
- Customer will host a subset of PHI data; we must validate retention and KMS/HSM keyflow before staging.
- Their infra team will need AWS peering or a transit gateway configured — may take 7–10 business days.

Notes for CS: sales committed a single canary rollout for 2 weeks and an SLO target of p99 inference latency < 250ms for 512-token runs; this was in the SOW. If additional infra is needed we have reserved bump capacity but need pre-approval from sales ops.

Please reply with owner and two candidate kickoff slots (preferably Sep 22 or Sep 23 mornings PT). Monica/Tessa — fyi for scheduling and runbook prep.
